svg.text: I build assistants that answer questions from a company's real data, in writing or by voice. Right now
I'm on a two-person team building one for hotel managers: they ask something like "how's my occupancy
this month?" and get the answer from live data.
The model never touches the database directly. It can only call a fixed set of tools, and every hotel
sees only its own data. That is the part I care about most, and the part I test the most.
